title: Cursor post row
description: A section title, a row of four small paper link cards (a muted date or meta line, a title, an optional byline with a 24px avatar) and an orange link under them. Cards darken one step on hover; on phones the row becomes a sideways scroller with the next card peeking in from the right edge.
notes: used by cursor-changelog and cursor-highlights; up to four cards look right on desktop
